# Weekly community update draft

This is a maintainer checklist, not a published announcement. Replace each prompt with verified facts before posting to [Announcements](https://github.com/SamStull9007/limitcast/discussions/categories/announcements).

## One improvement

What changed for a user? Link the release or commit and distinguish source-only changes from the npm release. If nothing shipped, say so.

## One visual or example

Use a relevant screenshot or short command result. Identify synthetic data. Remove private names, paths, credentials, and account information. User stories need explicit permission and review.

## One useful command

Explain when to use it and any required setup. Do not present estimates as cash savings or imply a configuration check proves live protection.

## One question

Ask a specific question that will influence the next change.

## Publish checklist

- [ ] Facts, release availability, and links verified.
- [ ] Any screenshot/output checked for private data and clearly labeled.
- [ ] User quotation and attribution approved, if applicable.
- [ ] Published as an Announcements discussion; add its URL below and close this draft.
